items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: And Freddie used to have his violin, I had an old guitar, just hit and didn't know what I was doing or whatever.

ctx.x: The mandolin. And he had a violin, but of course by me he left him to lay up and lay up and it just went to the jump power. Which did he start on, the violin or the mandolin? The violin first and then after the mandolin. Then he started with the card game. Then he played harmonica. When he was playing harmonica, then the last thing he picked up was the violin and I had a guitar with my mother and father. I was like a guitar, you know, I can't hear me. It wasn't a guitar exactly, but it was made out of old…
